data.description: Store full entity state in WAL WRITE entries to enable entity reconstruction from WAL alone. Currently, if crash happens after TX_COMMIT but before entity write completes, recovery knows the transaction committed but cannot reconstruct the entity data. This feature enables complete crash recovery by replaying committed writes from WAL.

properties.retrospective: Implemented WAL entity rollback feature. Full entity state is now stored in WAL WRITE entries, enabling recovery to reconstruct missing/corrupted entities after crash. Added 5 new behavioral tests covering: missing entity reconstruction, corrupted entity reconstruction, multi-entity recovery, uncommitted tx rejection, and end-to-end transaction manager integration. All 75 CDG behavioral tests pass.

data.title: Implement WAL entity rollback for crash recovery
